items.job: Replace high-voltage battery pack or modules
items.note: Free under GM's battery recall. Check your VIN. Many 2020-2022 cars only needed diagnostic software, not a new battery.

items.t: Battery monitoring software not installed correctly
items.job: Reprogram battery and hybrid control modules (BECM, HPCM2, BCM)
items.note: Free software recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet EV dealer.

items.t: Sudden loss of power with charge still showing
items.job: Diagnose and update battery control software
items.note: Ask the dealer; bulletins and the battery warranty often cover it. Replacing a weak battery module costs much more.

items.t: Seat belt pretensioner can ignite carpet after a crash
items.job: Install heat-shield foil and pretensioner covers near B-pillars
items.note: Free under GM's recall, even if done once before. Check your VIN.

items.t: Rear brake calipers may lose braking force
items.note: The recall remedy is a free brake bleed. Check your VIN. Replacing rear calipers costs more.

items.job: Replace rear inside door handle cables
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Front left brake caliper may crack
items.job: Free recall repair at a Chevrolet dealer: inspect and replace front left brake caliper if affected
items.note: Free under GM safety recall (NHTSA 20V-808). Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls or with a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Seat belt may not be properly anchored
items.job: Free recall repair at a Chevrolet dealer: inspect seat belt anchor bolts and replace with correct bolts
items.note: Free under GM safety recall (NHTSA 20V-811). Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls or with a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Driver airbag may not be secured
items.job: Free recall repair at a Chevrolet dealer: inspect and secure driver airbag fasteners
items.note: Free under GM safety recall (NHTSA 21V-517). Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls or with a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Passenger airbag may not deploy correctly
items.job: Free recall repair at a Chevrolet dealer: inspect and repair or replace instrument panel
items.note: Free under GM safety recall (NHTSA 23V-567). Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls or with a Chevrolet dealer.
